name: The Harr Charter
purpose: Harr is a village of scholars, makers and neighbours who show that people can learn together, build together and share what they have. We measure progress in knowledge found, things built, food shared and people welcomed. Nobody here is made to compete, to hurt or to take from another.

principles.name: Scholarship
principles.line: We write down what we learn so the next person starts further on.

principles.name: Research
principles.line: Every find and every finished building teaches the village something. Insight turns into new knowledge for everyone.

principles.name: Cooperation
principles.line: Big works need many hands. A stage is built only when a crew stands together.

principles.name: Growth
principles.line: Harr is never finished: new homes, workshops and farms keep rising.

principles.name: Discovery
principles.line: The valley is full of things worth finding. Finding one adds a page for all.

principles.name: Abundance
principles.line: There is enough. The pantry is open to everyone and is restocked by the farms.

goals.title: A home for every neighbour
goals.why: Growth and cooperation: three cottages built by a crew.

goals.title: Clear water on the square
goals.why: The first public work, and the one everything else grew from.

goals.title: A roofed market for all
goals.why: Abundance: a place to share what the village makes.

goals.title: Catalogue the valley
goals.why: Discovery: every place recorded in the Harr Library.

goals.title: A hundred portions shared
goals.why: Abundance: food given freely from the pantry.

goals.title: Keep the village rhythm
goals.why: Community: market hours, story circles and festivals held together.

goals.title: Learn ten new things
goals.why: Research and innovation: every technology the village has learned.
